purpose: Record a second source-distinct ACIS 21500 topology lift with exact source-byte binding, complete incidence comparison, and independent-kernel validation.

source.embeddedProducerMetadata: LibreDWG 0.14 minJSON reports AppInfo version 18.1.49.0.0 and AutoCAD product metadata; the DWG also carries a Trusted DWG comment. These embedded claims are not independently authenticated.

sourceExtraction.entityHandleRepresentation: minJSON handle array [0,2,507], matching hexadecimal handle 0x1FB
sourceExtraction.acisDataJoin: Concatenate the separately reported ACIS BinaryFile signature and the object's full hexadecimal acis_data payload.

independentLift.probeStatus: scratch-only; no changes were committed to either external repository

bridgeNormalization.scope: Disposable parsed-record copy used only to align typed accessor offsets before the kernel lift.

rows.vertex: retain the first two null pointers and final point pointer

bridgeNormalization.coedgeSense: Map F to forward and I to reversed for this scratch lift.

independentLift.result: PASS: exact source incidence and orientation comparisons pass; OpenCADKernel validates the lifted body with zero flaws.

limitations: This is a second source-distinct local drawing, not an independently authenticated producer release.
The direct lift requires scratch-only type-specific row normalization and F/I coedge-sense mapping; it does not validate the unmodified SAT parser or establish a version-wide grammar.
The ACIS 21500 header third integer remains semantically unresolved; raw value 2 is not called a body count.
This is not native AutoCAD/FreeCAD acceptance, a whole-DWG output test, a Linux/Windows qualification, or a general 3D support claim.
No DWG or DXF fixture was added to the repository.
claimEffect: Adds one bounded second-source ACIS 21500 topology lift after scratch normalization. It advances the source-distinct incidence gate while leaving header semantics, producer authentication, production SAT layout, native acceptance, whole-file output, and support promotion open.
